items.a: Upload your website, PDFs, or manual text. The system processes the content and your bot answers strictly from that knowledge.

items.q: How do I add it to my site?
items.a: After creating the bot, copy the single-line JavaScript snippet and paste it before the closing body tag. The widget appears in the corner automatically.
No. Follow the wizard and you'll have a bot in 5 minutes.

items.q: Does it work in Turkish and English?
items.a: Yes. The bot automatically replies in the visitor's language.
All data is encrypted and only your own bots can access it. GDPR and KVKK compliant.

items.q: What if the bot gives a wrong answer?
items.a: The bot only answers from your knowledge base. If it can't find the answer, it shows a lead form or asks for contact info.

items.q: Can I try it for free?
items.a: Yes — start on the Free plan without a credit card.
